reviews.author: Verified Resident
reviews.text: I have received little to no help with any of my issues regarding rent or mail. The Amazon hub won't work and I can't have packages delivered to me because the portal is broken. Amazon has stated the office should have a form but they claim there is no form. I have received no clear word about the promotional deal which was half the reason I chose to live here in the first place. I'm run around by the resident office and leasing office unable to get a certain answer. It's incredibly shady, unprofessional and upsetting. I currently have no plans of renewing my lease at this rate.

reviews.text: Run away don't come here, no hot water since winter, or you bring your Big pot to boil hot water for you and family. This has been every year. Summer the water is scotch Hot. The shower mixer/manifest does not mix hot and cold, can jumb very Hot at middle of showering, thus burning your body. My car was hit and run at midnight and the apartment couldn't get a surveillance camera of the other driver. Today 01/11/26. Even with the new management, in the midst of cold weather there is no hot water, this is about 12am midnight boiling water with my big pot just to get hot water. My pest control treatment request was marked completed without anyone coming into my unit. The new management uses AI to respond with text messages and nothing is getting done.

reviews.author: Nina nj
reviews.text: Don't waste your time here. There is absolutely no communication. After I paid the deposit for the application, we heard nothing for two straight weeks — no updates, no notifications, and no indication of whether the application was approved or denied. We tried repeatedly to contact them, but they didn't even bother to share their new email for updates until the last minute. I live an hour and a half away and had to drive to the office every weekend for nearly a month and a half just to get about five minutes of my questions answered. This experience was extremely frustrating and unprofessional.
